title: Gateway create refuses spark.databricks.cluster.profile and spark.master in spark_conf

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27, serverless and classic gateways

symptom: "The Gateway pipeline does not allow spark config [spark.databricks.cluster.profile, spark.master]". num_workers 0 was accepted without them.
effect: A gateway can't set those keys through spark_conf.
fix: Leave those keys out; set num_workers to 0 instead.
notes: A zero-worker gateway on classic compute stayed PENDING at Starting Spark and never completed an update (see classic-egress-blocks-source).
